notes.AL: Demonstrates reliance on AI as infallible authority; asks model to explain own work without skepticism or cross-verification of potential inaccuracies.
notes.PR: Provides contextual artifacts (PPT, IEEE paper) but prompts lack clarity and decomposition; relies on AI to structure the interaction rather than breaking the problem down logically.
notes.AUI: Strongest dimension; uses AI to bridge a general theoretical concept (micro-Doppler) to a specific practical application, showing an instinct for cognitive augmentation.
notes.EC: No behavioral evidence of validating outputs independently or challenging the AI's technical reasoning; accepts deep explanations and generated architectures without scrutiny.
notes.CS: Provides multiple sources but relies entirely on AI to integrate contexts and maintain coherence; the model does the balancing between CNN and Transformer approaches.
notes.CD: Follows highly predictable convergent paths; prompts are standard academic questions rather than demonstrating unconventional thinking or alternative explorations.
notes.ES: Not applicable to this academic presentation and technical signal processing query.
notes.CA: Low cognitive leadership; allows AI to dictate the entire narrative and structure; passively consumes outputs rather than orchestrating the collaboration.
